paragraphs.zh:
Fig. 2
Spektrum. Beschriftung der x-Achse wie gedruckt: "Wellenzahl cm-1". Die x-Achse laeuft von links nach rechts absteigend; beschriftete Teilstriche bei 3500, 3000, 2500, 2000, 1500, 1000, 500. Der linke Rahmenrand liegt bei 3500, der rechte Rahmenrand liegt etwas unterhalb von 500 (ungefaehr 30 cm-1, aus dem Teilstrichabstand geschaetzt). Die y-Achse traegt keine Beschriftung und keine Einheit; beschriftete Teilstriche bei 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, mit Dezimalpunkt gedruckt, nicht mit Dezimalkomma. Die Nulllinie liegt unten, die Banden zeigen nach oben; der obere Rahmenrand entspricht ungefaehr 0.94. Die Grundlinie liegt nahe null.
Sichtbar sind ungefaehr 80 bis 100 unterscheidbare Banden. Eine Bandengruppe im CH-Streckschwingungsbereich um 2900 bis 3100, dann ein weitgehend leerer Bereich zwischen ungefaehr 2800 und 1700 und ein dicht besetzter Fingerprintbereich unterhalb von 1700. Die staerksten Banden liegen ungefaehr bei 2930 und 2970 (Hoehe ungefaehr 0,70 bzw. 0,65), 2890 (ungefaehr 0,44), 1670 (ungefaehr 0,43), 1590 (ungefaehr 0,42) und 1150 (ungefaehr 0,46). Am aeussersten rechten Rand, bei ungefaehr 100 cm-1, steht die hoechste Linie des Blattes, sie erreicht fast den oberen Rahmenrand (ungefaehr 0,93). Alle diese Lagen sind vom Diagramm abgelesen und nur ungefaehr; die exakten Werte stehen in Tabelle 1 bzw. Tabelle 2.
paragraphs.en:
Fig. 2
Spectrum. The x axis caption as printed is "Wellenzahl cm-1" (wavenumber cm-1). The x axis decreases left to right; labelled ticks at 3500, 3000, 2500, 2000, 1500, 1000, 500. The left frame edge sits exactly at 3500 and the right frame edge sits a little below 500, at roughly 30 cm-1 estimated from the tick spacing. The y axis carries no caption and no unit; labelled ticks at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, printed with a decimal point and not a decimal comma. Zero is at the bottom and the bands point UPWARD; the top of the frame corresponds to about 0.94. The baseline sits close to zero.
Roughly 80 to 100 distinguishable bands are visible: a cluster in the CH stretching region around 2900 to 3100, a largely empty stretch between about 2800 and 1700, and a densely populated fingerprint region below 1700. The most prominent bands are at approximately 2930 and 2970 (heights about 0.70 and 0.65), 2890 (about 0.44), 1670 (about 0.43), 1590 (about 0.42) and 1150 (about 0.46). At the extreme right hand edge, near about 100 cm-1, stands the tallest line on the sheet, reaching almost the top of the frame at about 0.93. Every one of these positions is read off the plot and is approximate only; the exact values are printed in Tabelle 1 and Tabelle 2 and must be taken from there.
paragraphs.notes: The sheet DOES print a figure label, verbatim "Fig. 2", in large bold type below the left end of the x axis. It is printed as "Fig. 2", not as "Abbildung 2"; [0018] of the description names the six figures as Abbildung 1, 1a, 2, 2a, 3 and 3a. I take "Fig. 2" to be Abbildung 2, that is the Raman spectrum of crystal modification II, and the plot itself supports a Raman rather than an infrared reading: bands rise upward from a near zero baseline rather than dipping downward from a transmission ceiling, the y axis is an unnamed 0.0 to 0.94 scale rather than a percentage, and the abscissa continues past 400 cm-1 down to roughly 30 cm-1 with a very intense feature near 100 cm-1, a lattice mode region that a routine mid infrared measurement does not reach. Caveat: I see only this one sheet, and there are eight figure sheets for six Abbildungen, so I cannot confirm from here that no second sheet also carries a "Fig. 2" continuation.

notes: Figure sheet. The page carries a spectrum and NO chemical structure, so "drawings": [] is a finding and not an omission: there is nothing on this sheet with a core, substituents or a SMILES, and the spectrum is deliberately not forced into the structures schema. The text layer for this page is 19 characters, the running header "EP 2 045 236 A1" and the page number "17"; everything else on the sheet is an image, so the plot was read from the pixels. The axis numbers, the caption "Wellenzahl cm-1" and the label "Fig. 2" are set in the figure image itself and do not appear in the text layer. "doc_part" is given as "drawings", which is outside the three values listed in the prompt schema (front_page, claims, description); none of those describes a figure sheet, and doc_part is only echoed into a comment by build_enriched.py, not validated. Peak positions in the paragraph are approximations read off the plot and are flagged as such in both zh and en; they were NOT copied from Tabelle 1 or Tabelle 2 and must not be used where an exact wavenumber is needed. Vision pass performed by Claude Opus 5 (model id claude-opus-5[1m]).
doc_part_note: doc_part normalised to 'drawings' by the run owner after the V pass. The prompt's enum is front_page|claims|description and has no value for a figure sheet, so the six sheet agents split three and three between 'description' and 'drawings' on identical pages. Nothing validates this field (build_enriched.py:157 and make_visual_evidence.py:980 pass it through as a label), so the honest value is kept and made consistent rather than forced back into an enum that cannot express it. The agents' own reasoning is preserved in each file's notes.
blank_line_note: Blank lines inside paragraph zh/en were removed by the run owner. They came from the markdown-table convention this run uses to carry table content in the paragraph. build_enriched.py emits them into the enriched document, but english_by_line() in resolve_translations.py builds its `body` with `if t.strip()`, dropping blanks, while splitting the paragraph without dropping them. Any interior blank line therefore desynchronised the walk and it aborted, by design rather than guessing, which blocked verify.py for the whole run. Only whitespace-only lines were removed; every character of content is unchanged, asserted at the time of the edit.
